messages:
olivia: Quick heads-up — planning to unpin runtime v2.14 on canary tonight (23:00 PT). Need compatibility sanity check for quantized-llama3q and SDK 1.7. No full rollout until green.

deploy-bot: Scheduling window reserved: 2024-06-30 23:00 PT -> 2024-07-01 01:00 PT. Toggle through /deploy unpin runtime v2.14 canary

ben: On it. Running the model-interop suite now. I'll post failures if any. ETA ~20m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

carmen: Quick note: KV cache warmup test flaked once on longseq with q4_KV. Might be unrelated but tagging it.

drew: @ben when you run the smoke run pls include SDK 1.7.1 and 1.6.9 matrix — call out any behavior diffs.

ben: Ran smoke: majority green. One failure on rerank pipeline hitting OOM on a 16k seq config. Log: ```OOM while allocating 1.2GB on GPU0
model=llama3q_quant_v1
seq=16384
``` Trying a smaller batch.

carmen: That OOM looks like a batching policy regression post-unpin. Could be runtime kernel selection fallback. Adding kernel debug flags: `RUNTIME_KERNEL_DEBUG=1` and repro command:
```
./run_infer --model llama3q_quant_v1 --seq 16384 --batch 1 --profile-kernel
```

olivia: Good catch. If repro holds, we should delay unpin and add rollback criteria: 1) no new OOMs for 3 consecutive runs, 2) latency SLO within 10% of baseline, 3) no regression in quality metrics.

deploy-bot: If delayed, use /deploy postpone unpin 2h. Rollback command: `/deploy rollback runtime v2.14 --target canary`

ben: Re-run with smaller batch, passes. Kernel trace shows fallback to generic attention kernel at step 900. That's slower but not OOM. I'm going to instrument further and run the 3 consecutive runs.

drew: If the generic kernel appears, we should coordinate with eng-runtime to prioritize a hotfix kernel selection before full rollout. @carmen can you open an issue with traces?

carmen: Issue opened: RN-2246 — includes kernel traces and logs. Assigned to eng-runtime. I'll link PR when available.

olivia: Plan: Hold unpin for 90 minutes to gather traces. If eng-runtime posts a fix within that window, we re-evaluate; otherwise postpone to next window. Notify SRE and CS of potential customer impact.

ben: 3 runs completed, no OOMs, latency up 7% on longseq but within our threshold. No quality regressions observed on eval prompts.

olivia: Ok — proceeding to unpin at 23:45 PT. Deploybot, schedule.

deploy-bot: Unpin scheduled: 2024-06-30 23:45 PT. Will post status updates in thread. :white_check_mark:

olivia: Thanks team. If anything flips, call the rollback command and ping me.
